	// reprojected to 0..1 (tool/md3_carve_surface.py --project-only) so REAL mode can

	// authored skin at all. scope_real.zs swaps this for the camera texture when REAL.
	SurfaceSkin 0 10 "scope_glass.png"

	Offset -0.2816 -44.5467 0.0
	ZOffset -6.3157
	NoInterpolation

	// these the model silently stops drawing the instant the gun fires and the 2D sprite
	// shows for the whole rest of the sequence, because every state after it is "####"
	// and inherits X21F. gen_rsr.py knows ready_sprites only; it needs the fire sprites
	// too or a regenerate drops this.
	FrameIndex	X21F	A	0	0
	FrameIndex	P21F	A	0	0

	FrameIndex	X21F	B	0	0
